faq.a1: Personal conversions are free. Enabled single-file direct uploads accept up to 100 MB; batch and fallback uploads are limited to 4 MB per file. Batch is free during public beta.
faq.a2: BookConv supports 28+ formats including EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, PDF, DOCX, TXT, RTF, HTML, FB2, LIT, CBR, DJVU, JPG, PNG, and Word documents.
faq.q3: Is my data safe when I upload files?
faq.a3: Files move over HTTPS and are processed on servers. Some routes use third-party processing and output caching. See our privacy policy for retention details.
faq.q4: Do I need to install any software?
faq.a4: No installation is needed. Files are processed on servers using format-specific methods, including text extraction and third-party services. See the privacy policy for handling and retention.
faq.q5: Can I convert Kindle books to EPUB?
faq.a5: Yes! BookConv supports converting AZW3 and MOBI (Kindle formats) to EPUB and other formats. Simply upload your Kindle file and choose your desired output format.

codes.CONVERSION_FAILED: The conversion process failed. Try again or contact support with the error details.
codes.FILE_TOO_LARGE: File exceeds the 4 MB limit. Free tier has a 60-second hard timeout — large files will fail. Try: ① Pure JS formats (EPUB→TXT/DOCX/RTF/FB2 have no size limit); ② Compress or split the file; ③ Use desktop Calibre for large files.
codes.RATE_LIMIT: Too many requests. The limit is 20 conversions per minute. Wait a moment and try again.
codes.DRM_PROTECTED: The source file is DRM-protected. We cannot convert protected files.
codes.CORRUPT_INPUT: The uploaded file is corrupted or invalid. Please check the source file.

qualityChecklist.title: Quality Checklist

checks.fileSize: File size is reasonable (not 0 KB or unusually large)

qualityChecklist.note: If the quality isn't right, try converting from a different source format or adjusting the output settings.
